title: Joint Neural Posterior Estimation and Model Selection for Chemical Reaction Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.18825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation-based Bayesian inference for Chemical Reaction Networks (CRNs) must simultaneously solve two computationally demanding problems: discriminating between overlapping reaction pathways and estimating reaction rate constants. Classical approaches, such as Sequential Monte Carlo ABC, rely on handcrafted summary statistics and scale poorly across large parameter spaces. To overcome this, we introduce a neural inference architecture. Our pipeline utilizes shared 1D-CNNs and a permutation-invariant Set Attention mechanism to learn low-dimensional summary statistics from variable-length, multi-experiment time-series data. These statistics simultaneously condition a model selection network to compute posterior model probabilities and model-specific conditional Invertible Neural Networks (cINNs) that estimate parameter posterior distributions. We demonstrate the practical utility of our approach on a real protodeboronation example, illus

translated_title: 面向化学反应网络的联合神经后验估计与模型选择
translated_abstract: 针对化学反应网络的基于模拟的贝叶斯推断必须同时解决两个计算上极具挑战性的问题：区分相互重叠的反应路径以及估计反应速率常数。经典方法（如序贯蒙特卡洛近似贝叶斯计算，SMC-ABC）依赖手工设计的汇总统计量，且在大参数空间下扩展性较差。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种神经推断架构。我们的流程利用共享的一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）和置换不变的集合注意力机制，从变长的多实验时间序列数据中学习低维汇总统计量。这些统计量同时用于条件化一个模型选择网络以计算后验模型概率，以及针对各模型的条件可逆神经网络，用以估计参数后验分布。我们在一个真实的去硼酸化反应示例上展示了该方法的实际效用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合共享一维卷积神经网络与置换不变集合注意力机制的神经推断架构，可从多实验时间序列数据中同时完成化学反应网络的模型选择与参数后验估计，并在真实的去硼酸化反应示例中验证了其实用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neural inference architecture combining shared 1D-CNNs and permutation-invariant set attention to simultaneously perform model selection and parameter posterior estimation for chemical reaction networks from multi-experiment time-series data, demonstrated on a real protodeboronation example.
